visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large man wearing a black t-shirt with a graphic on the chest is sitting in a bright green stadium seat, shouting with his mouth wide open and fists clenched. The scene cuts to a wide shot of a baseball stadium with many spectators; three women in pink uniforms dance on a platform. (2) The man is joined by another male wearing a grey t-shirt; they sit side-by-side in the green stands. The large man looks at his smartphone screen with a serious expression, then looks up at his companion who points toward the field. (3) The large man is now standing against a green wall that features a large circular diagram of the 'Chengching Lake Baseball Stadium'. He holds his smartphone to his ear and uses his other hand to cover his mouth while blowing into it repeatedly. (4) Frequent cuts occur between the man by the green wall and a character played by the same man wearing a long black wig and a red headband, sitting indoors. The 'girlfriend' character looks suspicious while holding a phone. (5) The man in the grey shirt appears next to the large man by the stadium map, pointing at the camera. A close-up of a smartphone screen shows the 'FarEasTone 5G' signal strength bar and a social media interface with a video playing. (6) The large man addresses the camera directly in a medium shot, pointing his finger and gesturing towards his chest. He transitions from standing by the map to standing in front of the stadium stands under bright artificial lighting.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 2 main actors, several cheerleaders on stage, and numerous spectators in the stadium background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A large-framed man with a short buzz cut wearing a black graphic t-shirt, and a man with black hair wearing a grey polo shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A professional baseball stadium with green seats, a dirt field, and large screen displays. Also a green wall with a stadium floor plan and a simple indoor white-walled room.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with loud, rhythmic stadium chanting by multiple male voices, supported by a high-tempo electronic dance beat. The primary speaker shouts enthusiastically. (2) A notification sound effect (iOS chime) plays, followed by a shift to a fast-paced dialogue between two men. The BGM remains as a low-volume rhythmic bed. (3) A sudden burst of white noise (wind simulation) occurs as the speaker blows into the microphone. A feminine-pitched male voice (acting as a girlfriend) argues suspiciously with a sharp, high-arousal tone. (4) The BGM swells into a bright, celebratory pop track as the speaker transitions into a clear, professional narrative style, enunciating clearly about network speeds. (5) The audio concludes with a energetic brand slogan delivery over a punchy drum beat and synthesized melody, ending with a final percussive 'Yeah' exclamation.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Conflict -> Deceptive Resolution -> Promotional Climax -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the speed and stability of FarEasTone's 5G network. The video uses a comedic skit where a man tries to hide being at a baseball game from his girlfriend, but is caught because the network is too fast and clear, eventually pivoting to an explicit endorsement of the service's bandwidth.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names '遠傳' (FarEasTone) multiple times, shows the 5G signal bar on a phone, and lists technical benefits like total bandwidth.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video leverages local baseball culture and a relatable comedic scenario to market telecommunication services.
